description.zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for each request. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

description.zh: 是否设置为推荐服务发布到服务目录。
description.en: Specifies whether to recommend the service when publishing it to the Service Catalog.

descriptions.zh: 需要上线的服务必须为已通过审核的服务。
descriptions.en: Only approved services can be published.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier launch-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id service-0e6fca6a51a544xxxxxx --service-version 1.0 --categories DevOps --client-token 10CM943JP0EN9D51H --recommend false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier LaunchService --region cn-hangzhou --Recommend false --Categories.1 DevOps --ServiceVersion '1.0' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken 10CM943JP0EN9D51H --ServiceId 'service-0e6fca6a51a544xxxxxx'
